test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following years was the ‘Project Elephant’ launched by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1992.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Project-Elephant**:-

 
 
• It was launched by the Government of India in the year **1992** as a **Centrally Sponsored Scheme**.
 
• The **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** provides financial and technical support to major elephant range states in the country through this project.
 
• The **objectives** of this project are-
 
 
• To protect elephants, their habitat, and corridors.
 
• To address issues of man-animal conflict.
 
• Welfare of captive elephants.
 
 
 
• The project is being implemented in **16 states / UTs** .
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Indian Elephants:-**

 
 
• They occur in the **Central and Southern-Western Ghats**, **North-East India, Eastern India and Northern India** and, in some parts of the **Southern Peninsula**.
 
• It is included in **Schedule I of the Indian Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972,** and in **Appendix I of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species** of Flora and Fauna (CITES).
 
• **16 of the 28 states **in the country have Indian Elephants.
